name: Conditional Slicing Mechanism
definition: Conditions the 7D Gaussian on observed time $t$ and view direction $d$ to yield a conditional 3D Gaussian governing the spatial component, integrating temporal dynamics and view-dependent effects into the 3D rendering pipeline.
summary: The Conditional Slicing Mechanism conditions a 7D Gaussian on time and view direction to yield a spatial 3D Gaussian, explicitly modeling joint space-time-view distributions to shift spatial parameters based on rendering context.
